## 专业说明 {#overview}

<p><strong>官方名称：</strong>Spanish Language and Culture (International Honours)</p>

<p><strong>授予学位 / 项目类型：</strong>Undergraduate major within a bachelor degree</p>

<p><strong>目录适用期：</strong>2027</p>

<p><strong>目录条目类别：</strong>major</p>

<p><strong>申请路径：</strong>Degree-internal catalog field; not an independent degree</p>

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>课程内容与路径：</strong>2027 学位内语言与文化主修共 96 学分：24 学分核心为跨文化交流、国际研究方法及当代西班牙，32 学分从西班牙语语言与文化课中选择。另有 40 学分西班牙当地学习与田野研究，分为 16 和 24 学分两个项目。此为国际荣誉路径，须按所属学位条件选择，不能当作独立高中招生学位。</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-p-uts-handbook-maj09475">官方依据</a></p>

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>方向层级：</strong>本条是学位内主修，不是独立学士学位；方向学分不能当作整个学位学分、独立学制或另收一份学费。</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-p-uts-handbook-maj09475">官方依据</a></p>

## 入学条件 {#admissions}

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>已核对的承载学位：</strong>本轮直接在以下学位课程结构中找到本主修代码：C09167 Bachelor of Artificial Intelligence Bachelor of International Studies (Honours)；C09133 Bachelor of Business Bachelor of International Studies (Honours)；C09166 Bachelor of Cybersecurity Bachelor of International Studies (Honours)；C09147 Bachelor of Engineering (Honours) Bachelor of International Studies (Honours)；C09148 Bachelor of Engineering (Honours) Bachelor of International Studies (Honours) Diploma in Professional Engineering Practice；C09149 Bachelor of Forensic Science Bachelor of International Studies (Honours)；C09162 Bachelor of Information Technology Bachelor of International Studies (Honours)；C09153 Bachelor of Management Bachelor of International Studies (Honours)；C09156 Bachelor of Medical Science Bachelor of International Studies (Honours)；C09160 Bachelor of Science Bachelor of International Studies (Honours)。这些是已观察到的课程关系，不代表穷尽所有承载学位；申请、先修、方向名额及费用须按所选学位和路径核对。</p>
